description: The Pi adapter activates managed spawn, continuation, replacement, cursor, and reload declarations only when the configured build carries every mechanism oracle and the exact lifecycle conformance version. Its adapter-wide reconciliation strength remains bounded because authoritative transcript replacement does not resolve every externally effecting Operation outcome; deleting evidence or declaring adapter-wide authority fails the implementation oracle.
invariant_check: AdapterCapabilityAssuranceHonesty: the production Pi manifest is emitted only from the exact complete build-bound evidence set, declares bounded adapter-wide reconciliation plus manual-required external ambiguity, and never promotes authoritative transcript replacement into authoritative Operation-outcome reconciliation; each missing mechanism and wrong version must reject activation.
